agent_review.author: agent

findings.summary: Turn 16 forced Bushtank into 26-HP Sunflora, then turn 18 switched sleeping Bushtank to Coppertop; Coppertop absorbed sleep and two attacks before finishing Sunflora.

resolution.observed: Exact bounded replay forced full-health Croakatoa with no enemy action, then two Sludges KOed Sunflora while Croakatoa remained at 39 HP. This removes the Bushtank-to-Coppertop passive pivot.

findings.why_bad: The low-Sunflora threshold covered 22 HP but not the observed 26 HP damage roll.
findings.improvement: Expand the verified forced-Croak threshold to 26 HP and forbid switching while Croakatoa commits Sludge.
findings.next_test: Require Croakatoa to finish every Sunflora roll at or below 26 HP.

findings.summary: Turn 22 forced low Coppertop to Tackle faster Eelektrik; Coppertop fainted before acting while full Bushtank was a verified safe switch.

resolution.observed: After deleting the forced-Tackle rule, the exact checkpoint selected Bushtank, survived Shock Wave at 50/57, and the next certificate selected Razor Leaf rather than another switch.

findings.why_bad: An unconditional matchup preference overrode the safer action even when Coppertop could not move before fainting.
findings.improvement: Delete the over-specific Eelektrik Tackle preference and let verified survival and turn order rank the action.
findings.next_test: Ensure any Eelektrik pivot is followed by immediate damage, never another voluntary switch.

findings.summary: Lildozer, Birdlaw, Ohmnomnom, Coppertop, and Bushtank fainted; four produced verified progress, while Coppertop was the avoidable loss covered by the high finding.
findings.next_test: The corrected clone should preserve Coppertop and reduce total faints without weakening win reliability.

findings.summary: The win required 29 actions. The corrected Sunflora prefix removes three actions and one passive pivot.
findings.next_test: Target at most 26 actions unless verified battle variance requires more.

findings.summary: Turn 19 correctly classified sleep-prevented Tackle with no allied PP spend and no verifier discrepancy.

correct_choices: Turns 3 and 9 were the only productive voluntary matchup pivots; each target survived entry and immediately attacked.
Turns 7, 12, 16, 23, and 28 were forced replacements after verified faints, not switch spam.
All 29 actions reached authoritative boundaries and the battle ended in a verified win.
agent_review.next_test: Qualification stays at zero. Run clone 1 with unchanged behavior a614d987 only after this review gate accepts both resolved high findings.
